text:
olga_pm: Quick Q2 OKR milestone update: runtime v3 canary (dedicated) — shipped core API but 95th latency SLO failing in eu-west. Ship: core routing + canary config. Slipped: autoscale and quantization tuning. Owners listed below. TL;DR: need infra + runtime help by EOD to hit canary 2.

alex_eng: On it. Root cause looks like batch coalescing not respecting small request paths. Repro locally with loadgen.

priya_pm: Owners: alex (runtime), marcus (infra autoscale), lena (product tests). Can we get a short plan + PRs?

alex_eng: Plan: fix batching fallback + add unit test. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821 — needs review. ETA today afternoon.

marcus_infra: Autoscale policy tweak in sandbox pushed, will roll to canary after alex's fix. Also seeing instance churn in eu-west-2. Investigating. ping @omar_sre for AM.

omar_sre: I'll look at node churn logs. Can you paste the failing logs? deploy-bot shows recent canary deploy at 15:22 UTC.

alex_eng: Logs: ```ERROR kv_cache: eviction race at batch_coalesce.go:112``` Also adding extra metrics: batch_fill_ratio and active_kv_shards.

lena_pd: Product tests caught some rerank regressions — test set 42 failing. Might be quantization-related. If autoscale/latency fixed, we should hold quantization until next sprint.

priya_pm: :thumbsup: agree. Prioritize latency fix + autoscale for this canary. Quantization -> next milestone.

omar_sre: Found churn cause: node OOMs during heavy small requests. Marcus, can we add a memory headroom for canary pool?

marcus_infra: Yes, increasing reserved memory to +15% for canary; doing a controlled rollout.

alex_eng: I pushed small PR update and added test. Requesting review: @lena_pd @priya_pm for product impact, @omar_sre for load characteristics.

priya_pm: Reviewing now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy initiated for runtime-v3-canary at 18:05 UTC — target eu-west-2.

lena_pd: Product tests vs PR pass for unit tests, rerank still flaky — but CI shows improvement in latency 95th by ~30ms in staging.

alex_eng: Thanks. I'll monitor canary metrics. If stable for 2 hours we'll promote.

omar_sre: Node churn reduced after memory bump. Still watching swap pressure.

priya_pm: Next steps: alex monitor, marcus confirm autoscale policy in prod, lena hold quantization, omar keep SRE loop. If any blocker, escalate to oncall.

alex_eng: Will post update in 30m with metrics snapshot. PR link again: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821

priya_pm: :tada: thanks team — this keeps us on track for the OKR. Marking shipped/core with follow-up tasks for quantization.
